thread:
Lena (Support): Flagging urgent: NovaThera sees embedding timeouts and high tail latency during their onboarding demo. They mentioned they have a renewal checklist this week and are nervous. Ticket 478901.
Diego (CS Ops): Thanks — can you confirm deployment type and whether they saw errors on specific routes? I'll draft a short comms note.
Lena (Support): Dedicated NA cluster, model embed-lite-v2 (4-bit). Errors concentrated on /v1/embeddings/batch upsert route. 5xx spikes at ~14:10-14:25 UTC. Sample log:
```
TS=2026-02-18T14:13:09Z
REQ=95d2c
route=/v1/embeddings/batch
model=embed-lite-v2
status=504
latency_ms=1700
error=kv-cache-evict
```
A few calls retried successfully.
Aisha (CSM): I can join the customer call in 30m. Diego — can we offer a quick walk-through + temp routing to stable embed? We should avoid legal concessions.
Ravi (AE): Renewal call is Friday 16:00 local. Customer leaning positive but renewal contingent on smooth demo. We can offer a goodwill credit but prefer technical remediation first.
Mika (eng-runtime): Looking at traces. Pattern looks like large shared prefixes causing batch coalescing and frequent KV invalidations. Short-term mitigation: enable tenant-level single-request batching and route to embed-lite-stable. Can do a 1-hour mitigation window.
Diego (CS Ops): Proposed immediate comms (to customer): acknowledge, ETA 90m, propose temporary routing during demo hours + 500 free embed units. Aisha — want to own the message?
Aisha (CSM): I'll send. Draft: "Thanks for flagging — we're on it. We'll run a short mitigation during your demo window and follow up with a technical review + permanent fix plan." Sending now.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-8421 (priority: urgent) — assignee: eng-runtime.
Lena (Support): Logged full request traces into INC-8421. Also confirming autoscale mode: dedicated fixed pool, burst off.
Mika (eng-runtime): Implemented feature-flag: tenant_force_single_batch=true for NovaThera. Also routed their key demo routes to embed-lite-stable for 2 hours. Monitoring now.
Diego (CS Ops): Great. Action items:
- Mika: monitor and propose a durable config change by EOD.
- Aisha: run 30m enablement with customer now and capture repros.
- Lena: keep ticket updated and paste any new 5xxs here.
- Ravi: prepare renewal note: outcome + next steps template.
Aisha (CSM): Live enablement done. We repro the latency once; after routing to stable model latency normalized. Customer: "Thanks — this helps. We'll assess in renewal."
Mika (eng-runtime): Early data: 5xxs dropped to zero during mitigation window. I'll open RFC for batch heuristic tweak and tenant-aware cache sizing.
Diego (CS Ops): I'll circulate a post-session status email and proposed comms for Ravi to use in the renewal meeting. Draft to include timeline, credit offered, and engineering next steps.
Ravi (AE): Thanks team. I'll keep pressure low on concessions during Friday's call and emphasize the engineering plan.
Lena (Support): Closing loop with support customer note: mitigation applied and engineering investigating.
ops-bot: Label cs-priority added to INC-8421.
Diego (CS Ops): We'll reconvene tomorrow 10:00 UTC for the postmortem. Thanks everyone."
